verdict.rationale: Notion's REST API, webhooks, and OAuth-based public connections (notion-docs-1,3,4) could technically let a design tool push status updates into Notion, but there is no evidence of an actual design-tool integration (e.g., Figma) or of any workflow letting a designer update status without leaving their design app. Missing for 10: a documented design-tool-specific integration or plugin, evidence of real-world usage by designers, and confirmation the API supports the exact 'status update' use case without custom development.
